suites.description: Validate CI manifests, matrices and JUnit generation.
Validate truth configuration and every generated file.
command: ./regressions/truth/sync.sh && git diff --exit-code -- kernel/dmtcp/include/soc.h rtl/soc/topology_pkg.sv rtl/core/core_pkg.sv rtl/memory/memory_pkg.sv rtl/sys_arr/sys_cnfg_pkg.sv regressions/truth/sim.env user/include/sysarr/config.h

suites.description: Compile and run the fast host userspace tests.
Validate all lint file lists before tool invocation.
Fast Verilator compile/lint of the core.
Rebuild kernel, userspace and simulator with the small truth configuration.
Boot the currently committed truth configuration through userspace.
Run the complete supported host regression set.
Run the supported Verilator lint flow on the core.
Run short bounded CDC handshake and reset synchronizer proofs.
command: make -C verification/formal/cdc prove && make -C verification/formal/rdc prove

suites.description: Build and run the UART UVM environment.
command: source /home/geeth/AltairDSim/2026/shell_activate.bash; export DSIM_LICENSE=/home/geeth/metrics-ca/dsim-license.json; cmake -S verification/uvm/uart -B build/uvm/uart && cmake --build build/uvm/uart --target dsim_run

suites.description: Build and run the isolated ISA UVM with the default deterministic seed.
Boot every selected nightly SoC configuration to userspace.
Run every userspace test with the committed truth configuration.
Run the supported Verilator lint flow on every RTL target.
command: for target in chip core noc memory uart; do make -C verification/lint TARGET="$target" verilator; done

suites.description: Run all available full formal proof targets.
command: make -C verification/formal/regfile prove && make -C verification/formal/uart prove && make -C verification/formal/cdc prove && make -C verification/formal/rdc prove

suites.description: Run isolated ISA UVM with three deterministic random seeds.
command: source /home/geeth/AltairDSim/2026/shell_activate.bash; export DSIM_LICENSE=/home/geeth/metrics-ca/dsim-license.json; for seed in 1 2 3; do ISA_RANDOM_SEED="$seed" verification/uvm/isa/scripts/run.sh; done

suites.description: Compile small DMCTP integer, control, constant and system cases and validate every instruction against isa.yaml.
Exercise optimization levels, deterministic random code, atomics and load/store stress through the DMCTP backend.
Reach userspace and run every userspace test on every allowed SoC configuration.
Run all available formal cover targets.
command: make -C verification/formal/regfile cover && make -C verification/formal/uart cover

suites.description: Run CDC and RDC development checks on every supported target.
command: for target in core memory soc sys_arr uart; do make -C verification/cdc "$target" && make -C verification/rdc "$target"; done

suites.description: Run a wider deterministic ISA random-seed campaign.
command: source /home/geeth/AltairDSim/2026/shell_activate.bash; export DSIM_LICENSE=/home/geeth/metrics-ca/dsim-license.json; for seed in 11 23 37 51 67 83 101 127; do ISA_RANDOM_SEED="$seed" verification/uvm/isa/scripts/run.sh; done
